name: Fake Door / Ghost Feature Test
phase: Low-Fidelity Prototyping and Smoke Testing Tactics
hypothesis: We believe that existing active users need [Feature X]. We will verify this by adding an entry point for the unbuilt feature within our live interface, and consider it validated if ≥ 12% of active users click the link within 7 days, with ≥ 50% opting into an early access notification list.
schematic: Read at stage 3 of the 3-stage funnel

plan.label: Preparation
plan.text: Design a native entry point for the unbuilt feature with a modal offering an early-access waitlist.

plan.label: Execution
plan.text: Ship it to a randomised slice of active users behind an open-source feature flag.

plan.label: Data collection
plan.text: Track exposures, click-through and opt-in conversions on the modal.

planFull.label: Preparation
planFull.text: Design a native UI element (button, menu entry, or card) for the proposed capability. Build an exit modal explaining: "We are currently finalizing this feature. Join the early access waitlist to get notified when it launches."

planFull.label: Execution
planFull.text: Deploy the element to a randomized slice of active users using an open-source feature flag manager.

planFull.label: Data collection
planFull.text: Track exposures, click-through rates, and opt-in conversions on the explanation modal.

warning.label: Curio-Clicking
warning.text: Users click novel buttons out of curiosity, not because they want the feature.

warningFull: Users frequently click unexpected buttons simply out of curiosity or novelty, rather than a genuine intent to use the underlying feature.
